events.title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.display_title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.description:
This summer, Pretend City Children’s Museum teamed up with OC Waste & Recycling to bring hands-on vermicomposting education to young learners! ♻️🪱🌱 Through interactive presentations and activities, kids explore how worms help recycle food scraps into nutrient-rich compost, learning firsthand how small actions can make a big impact for our planet! Together, we’re making organics recycling fun, engaging, and accessible for the next generation of environmental stewards. 
Time: 10 am  
Included with museum admission 
Activities take place throughout the day while supplies last. 
*Events and times are subject to change.
About the play partner: OC Waste & Recycling serves the County’s solid waste disposal needs by providing waste management services, operating public landfills, protecting the local environment, investing in renewable energy enterprises and promoting recycling in order to ensure a safe and healthy community for current and future generations. OCWR also provides education, outreach, and sustainability programs that help residents reduce waste and support state and local mandates. 
 
Frequently Asked Questions 
What is Getting Wiggly with Composting program? 
Getting Wiggly with Composting is a hands-on environmental learning experience at Pretend City Children’s Museum in Irvine, California, where children discover how worms turn food scraps into nutrient-rich compost through vermicomposting. 
Is this activity included with admission?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities are included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
The experience is designed for children ages 3–12 and their families. 
Will kids see real worms?
Yes. Children can learn about real worms and how they help break down food scraps into compost. 
Are there other days to attend this program?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities will take place on June 6, June 16, June 23, and June 30 from 10 am – 2 pm while supplies last.

About Play Partner: Mike Alfaro is a Creative Director, Content Creator, and Children’s Book Writer with over 400k followers on social media (@millennialloteria). Yes. The vermicomposting activities are included with regular museum admission.

The experience is designed for children ages 3–12 and their families.

events.title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.display_title: Getting Wiggly with Composting with OC Waste and Recycling
events.description:
This summer, Pretend City Children’s Museum teamed up with OC Waste & Recycling to bring hands-on vermicomposting education to young learners! ♻️🪱🌱 Through interactive presentations and activities, kids explore how worms help recycle food scraps into nutrient-rich compost, learning firsthand how small actions can make a big impact for our planet! Together, we’re making organics recycling fun, engaging, and accessible for the next generation of environmental stewards. 
Time: 10 am  
Included with museum admission 
Activities take place throughout the day while supplies last. 
*Events and times are subject to change.
About the play partner: OC Waste & Recycling serves the County’s solid waste disposal needs by providing waste management services, operating public landfills, protecting the local environment, investing in renewable energy enterprises and promoting recycling in order to ensure a safe and healthy community for current and future generations. OCWR also provides education, outreach, and sustainability programs that help residents reduce waste and support state and local mandates. 
 
Frequently Asked Questions 
What is Getting Wiggly with Composting program? 
Getting Wiggly with Composting is a hands-on environmental learning experience at Pretend City Children’s Museum in Irvine, California, where children discover how worms turn food scraps into nutrient-rich compost through vermicomposting. 
Is this activity included with admission?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities are included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
The experience is designed for children ages 3–12 and their families. 
Will kids see real worms?
Yes. Children can learn about real worms and how they help break down food scraps into compost. 
Are there other days to attend this program?
Yes. The vermicomposting activities will take place on June 6, June 16, June 23, and June 30 from 10 am – 2 pm while supplies last.

events.title: Artists in Action with Chuck Jones
events.display_title: Artists in Action with Chuck Jones
events.description:
Artists in Action with Chuck Jones Center for Creativity invites families to explore creativity together through hands-on experiences led by real artists. Each visit offers new materials, fresh ideas, and playful ways for children to express themselves and connect through art.
Times: 11am-12pm 
About the play partner: 
Founded upon the time-honored philosophies of legendary, Oscar-winning animation director Chuck Jones, the Chuck Jones Center for Creativity is a 501c3 charity dedicated to stimulating innovative thinking, individual expression and interpersonal collaboration – on its mission to nurture creative solutions to some of society’s most urgent and unmet needs. Our programs for youth (including those on the autism spectrum), adults of all ages, schools, businesses and organizational teams focus on elevating, celebrating and accelerating the creative genius in all of us, all for the betterment of the individuals, the groups and the communities we serve.
Frequently Asked Questions 
Is this program included with museum admission?
Yes. Artists in Action is included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
This experience is designed for children ages 0–8 and their families. 
Is this a structured class?
No. This is a drop-in, open-ended creative experience where families can participate at their own pace. 
When should we arrive?
Families can drop in anytime between 11:00 am and 1:45 pm. 
Will materials be provided?
Yes. All materials are provided as part of the experience. 
Will Chuck Jones Center for Creativity be back?
Yes. The Chuck Jones Center for Creativity will return for additional sessions on June 25 and July 22. 
Who is Chuck Jones?
Chuck Jones was a legendary, Oscar-winning animation director best known for creating and directing beloved characters like Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, and the Road Runner. His legacy continues through the Chuck Jones Center for Creativity, which inspires people of all ages to explore creativity and innovation. 
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. 
Included with museum admission 
Books will be available for purchase during the event.
